title: Acid Smog
body:
The Acid Smog is a medium-sized cave within the Acidlands caves. To find it, go left from the Acidlands entrance until you get into a cave. There, you can find a hole that goes down into the smog.

Description

This region is characterized by a very dark, choking atmosphere that constantly deals damage to players. The terrain consists of a few islands or juts from the surrounding walls, most of which containing large pillars and green crystals similar to those seen in the Boomite or Quartz caves, along with skeletons of some distant leviathan creatures. It has two entrances, both of which are in the Acid caves, and both are on the north/back of the island. Many of the acid rivers within the caves flow into the lakes in this biome, very slightly visible from the upper levels of the acid caves. 3 hostile NPCs can be found here; the normal Skeletons, armored skeletons, and goblin dogs. One of the key differences between the Acid Smog and the rest of the island is the unusually high spawn rate of Uranium, commonly being the majority of all ore nodes that spawn, and the lack of Greeb or Ink nodes.

Strategy

The Acid Smog features a toxic, dense gas that constantly deals damage to anyone inside. Because of this, and the hostile NPCs, a healing coil or fusion coil is absolutely required to survive in this biome. Mining ores is challenging, as anything short of an Uncertain Pickaxe deals such low damage, or such a small radius, that mining one node could take several minutes. Navigating this region is also difficult without night vision or a flashlight, as there is almost no light within this region and multiple bridges over extremely deadly acid rivers. Should the player survive long enough to get a few trailers of ore, however, and manage to forge the uranium, they can expect to bring in well over $100,000 from one mining trip in just this part of the Acid Lands, if not $2-300,000.
